//: Full MCP catalog (Windows, Claude Code). This is a CATALOG, not a live config. Copy to a project root as .mcp.json and DELETE everything that project doesn't need — running >5 active servers degrades tool selection. Servers tagged [key] won't start until you set the env var; keep secrets OUT of git (set them as environment variables). Package names verified June 2026.

context7.//: Up-to-date, version-specific library docs — kills hallucinated APIs. No key (optional CONTEXT7_API_KEY raises rate limits).

playwright.//: Browser automation + E2E testing via the accessibility tree. No key.

sequential-thinking.//: Structured multi-step reasoning for hard problems. No key.

memory.//: Knowledge-graph memory across sessions. Overlaps claude-mem — pick ONE. No key.

filesystem.//: Filesystem access scoped to the given root(s). EDIT the path to the project you copy this into. No key.

deepwiki.//: Ask questions about any public GitHub repo's docs. No key.

github.//: [key] GitHub's OFFICIAL remote MCP (PRs, issues, repos, actions). NOTE: the old npm @modelcontextprotocol/server-github is deprecated. Needs a PAT in GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN. Docker alternative: ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server.

supabase.//: [key] Supabase: tables, config, SQL, edge functions. '--read-only' is a safety default — drop it to allow writes. Needs SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN.

postgres.//: [key] Read-only Postgres: inspect schema + run SELECTs. Put your URL in DATABASE_URL. For writes / health checks / index tuning use 'Postgres MCP Pro' (uvx postgres-mcp).

n8n.//: [key optional] Build/inspect n8n workflows. Works in docs-only mode with no key; set N8N_API_URL + N8N_API_KEY to manage a live instance.

exa.//: [key] Web/code search (hosted). Needs an Exa account/key on their side.

brave-search.//: [key] Privacy-friendly web search. Needs BRAVE_API_KEY (free tier available).
